title: Origin story: Inkbound
description: Inkbound was a lawyer's clerk who read a contract too carefully and found the devil's clause — literally. He bound the devil to its own terms and took its place as keeper of the infernal contracts, and he runs the office fairly: the terms are terrible, but they are exactly as written, and he enforces them on demons too.

title: Power ranking: Inkbound
description: Powers: His ink binds demons and men alike; He finds the clause no one read; The office obeys its keeper.

title: Stamina feats: Inkbound
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Read contracts for a century; Enforced fairness in hell's bureaucracy.
